featured_reviews.name: Su Abdulla
featured_reviews.review_text:
My sessions with Aruna were life changing! If there is one place I’d ask you to invest your money is in EMDR and Aruna is one of the best in the field. I had previous experience with EMDR for about a year with Harini Iyer, who is also amazing.

What’s different about Aruna is that she really gets deep into the core and root of the issues. She’s very to-the-point and gets down to business immediately, I initially found that a bit abrupt because there was no warm chitchat, but over time I actually liked that about her because she’s 100% focused on helping you resolve your issues.

A lot of my friends have sessions with her and I always recommend her highly to anyone I know. Don’t think twice about doing your sessions with her - the process is intense, messy and makes you want to give up many times, but there is a brilliant, beautiful light at the end of the tunnel, and it’s totally gonna be worth it. Don’t quit and keep at it. A game changer in your life! I wish I’d discovered EMDR earlier in life, but better late than never. I did 2 years of EMDR and I combined the last 3 months of my EMDR with DBT and I found that combination very rewarding as well. You don’t need this combo early in your EMDR journey but would recommend it to spot some patterns you’re unaware of once you’ve worked on your most obvious ones.

I can say that I’ve actually moved from an anxious attached person towards a secure person over these 2 years. I’m able to regulate my emotions better and also sit with the discomfort of my emotions. I’m learning to be comfortable with the uncertainty of the future - lack of clarity used to give me a lot of anxiety before. I’m also able to welcome emotions like anger, sadness, shame and grief which I would avoid and suppress before. It feels so good to accept all your emotions. I’ve also become less conflict avoidant though I’m still learning how to communicate in a respectful manner without blame, accusations & triggering the other person - that’s work outside of EMDR though. My sense of self worth has increased, my boundaries are stronger, I am able to walk away from unhealthy relationships, voice my needs without fear, and overall be one of the strongest versions of myself.

It feels so liberating to live life authentically without suppressing yourself for the sake of others. I feel grateful to Allah for guiding me towards EMDR and Aruna. 10/10 recommend.
